# OneTra Health

> Validation-stage adult oncology decision support. Deterministic rule matching, source-traceable evidence, clinical-document processing, and safe abstention.

- Home: https://onetra.vercel.app/
- Validator: https://onetra.vercel.app/dashboard
- Login (public demonstration access; no Google authentication in this phase): https://onetra.vercel.app/login
- Security/Privacy: https://onetra.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms: https://onetra.vercel.app/terms
- Contact: mailto:hello@onetra.health

## What OneTra does

OneTra evaluates a structured adult oncology case against a clinically audited rule corpus.

Doctor 1 returns a single deterministic recommendation or abstains when criteria are not met.
Doctor 2 surfaces source and evidence labels attached to a Doctor 1 match.
Doctor 3 performs bounded, grounded analysis of an uploaded de-identified clinical document, or returns SILENCE.
VEDA is the clinical-document processing path.

Numeric patient age is required. Adult oncology only (18+).
Use synthetic or de-identified cases only. Do not submit patient-identifying information.
Clinician judgment is required. OneTra is not an approved medical device.

## What OneTra does not do

It does not ingest electronic health records, rank multiple treatment lines, match clinical trials, learn from outcomes, or replace a treating oncologist.
Doctor 3 does not compare serial cases over time.

## Live intake coverage

The public validator exposes every cancer type present on at least one of the current 315 frozen Doctor 1 rules. Downstream stage, line, and biomarker lists are constrained to combinations that appear on those rules.

The live matcher may still abstain when a rule needs fields the public intake cannot send. That abstention is expected and is not a fabricated recommendation.

A proven positive live demonstration case is non-small cell lung cancer, stage IV, first line, MET exon 14 skipping, adult numeric age.
